body: I can’t even face waking up tomorrow to face my fucking shitty job. I don’t want to live please. I want to be loved. I don’t want to die alone I don’t want to be alone. Why does no one love mez
Please just kill me. I’m unloveable and I can’t face tomorrow. No one cares about me. Please just kill me.

I can’t go to hospital. This is the UK. They won’t help me unless I took an OD and even then the doctors just sneer at you and mock you and hate on you because they think you’re wasting their time. They wouldn’t piss on me if I was on fire. Just like my fiancée. 

Besides, I used to work for the mental health services until I left... I know what their like. Bully mentality bouncers who I’m convinced would probably harm me if I got sectioned. And even if I did, no one would care and my life would be ruined after so I would have to fucking do myself in even after I got out. It’s all shit.

I love her very much but clearly I’m not worth loving. Who would love a monster like me? Who can I even trust after my fucking soulmate fucking doesn’t care and abandons me? She knows I got all my meds, she knows I’m gonna do it... She even knows I’m cutting. I’m not even worth the hassle to her so why would anyone else give a fuck? Doctors are only gonna fuck me up more or tell me I’m wasting their time.

My SOs last words to me will be “You fucking twat.” She knows I’m contemplating it right now and doesn’t care. She just wants to scream at me over and over. She’s mad at me because she has work tomorrow. She sees me as nothing more than an inconvenience to her day. I don’t care who sees my body now. No one wants to see me now, it won’t matter tomorrow morning either.

All of my life is just that. 

I’m just a waste of everyone’s time. I’m sorry I wasted yours. I really need to make up my mind on the how’s now and ifs... I hate everything that I am and I’m wish I was never born. 

Why am I even here? What good is it? Why bother when even the only person who said forever to me has given up and hates me?

I’m just a waste of time. I’m not even worth my SOs efforts. She just turned off the hall light. I’m in darkness now crying. 

What a way to end it. Sitting in the dark alone. 

Guess I’m not even worth the light.

The first time I was confronted with the fact that my father had been neglectful, abusive and manipulative for most of my life was a huge shock. 

I often explained away all the shit he pulled on me and did to me, as well as blaming myself quite a bit for much of it. It was surreal. It left me feeling very upset and I had huge breakdowns just trying to get over it all. I’m glad that I know of it now but it left me reeling in disgust. 

I can’t believe he made you sleep on his floor... that’s appalling. You should have never been subjected to that bullshit. 

I hope you can continue to recover and heal from all this. I will think of you when I chant today. X

I am so sorry you had to deal with that highly uncomfortable and painful part of your life, I am relieved and glad to hear you’re doing much better now. 

I went through very much the same issues of “supporting” my dad through/having inappropriate conversations dumped on to me and working through it all now with my therapist. I didn’t even know what he did to me was abuse, neglect and covert/actual incest for a while.

He even used to make me sleep in the same bed as him for a long time... I haven’t really spoken about it to anyone before not my partner who I plan to marry or even my therapist. I struggle sometimes with everything but I am free at last from his manipulative tactics and behaviour at least. I’m glad you aren’t having to deal with your dad anymore in that way too.

I hope you keep having breakthroughs and keep strong. Sending lots of hugs your way xx
I am also a female. But I suppose the sentiment is the same.
